text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":270799,"ns":0,"title":"Instrumentalism","extract":"In philosophy of science and in epistemology, instrumentalism is a methodological view that ideas are useful instruments, and that the worth of an idea is based on how effective it is in explaining and predicting natural phenomena.\nAccording to instrumentalists, a successful scientific theory reveals nothing known either true or false about nature's unobservable objects, properties or processes.","description":"Position in the philosophy of science","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
